battle.name: 石堡城之戰
battle.brief: 開元十七年（729）秋，吐蕃聯同吐谷渾攻取湟水南岸的石堡城，唐守卒與城民或戰或降，城陷後由吐蕃接管，唐通往青海的咽喉自此受制。此後二十年唐軍屢攻不下，直到天寶八載（749）哥舒翰苦攻數月才重新克復。卡面的羅馬方陣盾屬古典地中海裝備，與唐蕃戰場並無交集。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 石堡城之戰的交戰雙方，是唐王朝的西北邊軍與吐蕃聯軍。唐朝一方以隴右、河西兩道的邊防軍為主體：河西節度使司管轄涼州、甘州、肅州一線，隴右節度使司管轄秦、洮、岷、階一線，石堡城所在的湟源一帶正卡在兩鎮之間，是唐防禦吐蕃的前哨。守城者為配置在湟源的邊軍與城丁，隸屬鄯州、湟州一帶的州鎮，總兵力史籍未詳，只知是一支規模不大的守禦部隊。吐蕃一方是吐蕃王國的部落聯軍，主力為吐蕃本部的騎兵與步兵，並糾集吐谷渾、黨項（生羌）等高原部族分擔攻堅與偵察，軍中糧秣靠隨軍放牧的牛羊群供應；至於人馬數以十萬的說法，多出自唐人記錄，實際投入兵力應當遠少於此。吐蕃此時已控制青海一帶，與唐在邊境線上形成長期拉鋸：石堡城正扼湟水通道，取下此城，等於把唐朝的邊防線整條往盆地內側推移。兩軍在城下的交鋒沒有談判、沒有交換，結果以城易手告終。
countriesEn: The two sides in the Battle of Shibao were the frontier army of the Tang dynasty and a Tibetan-led coalition. On the Tang side the field army was drawn from the frontier commands of Longyou and Hexi: the Hexi Circuit covered the line from Liangzhou, Ganzhou and Suzhou, while Longyou Circuit held Qin, Tao, Min and Jie, and the Shibao area around Huangyuan lay exactly between the two commands, serving as the Tang outpost against Tibet. The garrison consisted of Longyou and Hexi border troops together with the enrolled townsmen of the prefectures of Shan and Huang, and the numbers are not recorded in the sources beyond the fact that it was a small defensive detachment. The Tibetan side was a tribal coalition of the Tibetan Empire, with the cavalry and infantry of the Tibetan core supplemented by peoples of the plateau such as the Tuyuhun and the Dangxiang, who took part in the assault and in reconnaissance, with food for the army supplied by cattle and sheep herded along with the column. Claims of a hundred thousand or more men come from Tang records and are plainly inflated; the real force committed was considerably smaller. Tibet already held the area around Qinghai Lake and had been trading blows with the Tang along the frontier for years, and Shibao sat astride the Huangshui corridor. To take it was to push the entire Tang defence line inward toward the basin. Nothing was negotiated and nothing was exchanged; the contest was settled by the change of hands.
people: 史籍對石堡城之戰的將帥記載相當簡略，留下姓名的主要是唐代事後追敘的臣僚與當事人。唐廷在開元十七年前後主持西北邊務的是河西節度使崔希逸與隴右一方的將佐，而真正主持石堡城爭奪、並在二十年後為這條戰線作結的，是後來在唐蕃邊境屢建功名的哥舒氏家族。哥舒翰在天寶八載（749）攻拔石堡城，是此線二十年僵局的終點；他的用兵特色是先斷敵後路、再以重兵壓上，士卒死傷極重仍不肯退。與他並列被提及的還有封常清、趙狅等人，都是唐廷派往隴右的將領。吐蕃方面，贊普的名諱在這一年的記錄中並未出現，通常只以吐蕃或西蕃概稱，說明唐人對其指揮體系的了解有限；可以確定的是，吐谷渾一帶的部眾被編入攻城序列，顯示吐蕃以宗主身分統合高原部落的聯合作戰方式已相當成熟。唐詩人岑參的〈石堡城〉一詩是此役在文獻中留下最生動的記錄之一，詩中「石堡城上建牙旗」一句，寫的正是城頭易幟的景象。歷代史家評此役，多從唐朝邊防長期受制於一城這一點立論，而不追究單場戰鬥的得失。
peopleEn: The records of commanders at Shibao are thin, and the names that survive come mostly from Tang officials writing after the event. The men running north-western frontier affairs around Kaiyuan 17 were the Hexi jiedushi Cui Xiyi and the commanders of the Longyou side, while the man who finally settled the contest on this front two decades later was Geshu Han, of the Geshu family whose name recurs throughout the Tang-Tibetan border wars. His seizure of Shibao in the eighth year of Tianbao (749) closed a twenty-year stalemate; his method was to cut the enemy's rear first and then press with heavy troops, accepting enormous losses rather than pulling back. Named alongside him are Feng Changqing and Zhao Yan, both generals the Tang sent to Longyou. On the Tibetan side the name of the btsan po does not appear in the record for this year, and the enemy is simply called Tibet or the western tribes, which shows how limited the Tang understanding of their command structure was. What is certain is that Tuyuhun troops were drawn into the assault columns, indicating that the Tibetan practice of integrating the plateau peoples as subordinate allies was already well developed. The Tang poet Cen Shen's poem 'On Shibao City' is one of the most vivid literary records of the affair, and its line about raising the war banners on the walls of Shibao depicts the moment the fortress changed hands. Later historians treat the episode less as a single engagement than as the reason the Tang frontier remained pinned down by one fortress for two decades.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾屬於古典地中海的步兵裝備體系：凸面的長方盾，盾緣互相咬合成排，靠整列而不是靠單面厚度去抵擋投射物。它在西元前一世紀已經定型，卻與開元十七年的青藏戰場毫無關係——唐蕃交戰雙方使用的完全是另一套器械。唐軍這一代的裝備以弓弩為遠射骨幹，臂弩與床弩在城頭與隘道一線居高臨下射擊，步卒以長槍、陌刀與橫刀近身格鬥，鎧甲以皮甲為主、將領與精騎用明光鐵甲，騎兵靠馬鎧與長槍作戰，攻城則備有雲梯、撞車、火箭與壕塹器械。吐蕃軍的裝備另有特色：弓弩拉力大而射程短，靠大量輕騎在山地散開、各自為戰，擲石與長矛投擲是攻堅前削弱城頭的常用手段，甲胄以皮甲、鎖子甲為主，軍中最特殊的是隨軍攜帶龐大牛羊群，以畜群供給軍食與騎乘，這在唐代文獻中屢見提及，是高原部族作戰的傳統。兩套體系唯一共通之處，是都把裝備標準化與隊形紀律視為戰力根本：羅馬靠方陣盾的咬合維持前線，唐軍靠長槍拒馬與弩箭齊射維持進退。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scutum, a piece of the infantry equipment system of the classical Mediterranean: a convex rectangular shield whose rims lock edge to edge, so that a line of them, rather than the thickness of any single board, turns back missiles. The type was already settled by the first century BC, yet it has no connection whatsoever with the Tibetan plateau battlefield of Kaiyuan 17; the two sides fought with entirely different tools. Tang equipment of this generation rested on bows and crossbows for reach: handheld and mounted crossbows fired down from wall-heads and defiles, while infantry closed with long spears, the miao dao and the heng dao; armour was mostly leather, with brigades of iron and bright plate for officers and elite cavalry, and mounted troops fought with barding and long spear. For siege they had scaling ladders, rams, fire arrows and trenching tools. The Tibetan equipment was different in character: bows of high draw and short range, a great many light horsemen spread across the hills and fighting in small independent groups, with thrown stones and cast spears used to thin the defenders on the wall before the assault, and armour of leather and mail. Most distinctive was the vast herds of cattle and sheep carried along with the column to furnish rations and mounts, a habit of the plateau peoples recorded repeatedly in Tang texts. The one common feature of the two systems is that both treated standardised equipment and unit discipline as the root of fighting power: Rome held its line by the interlocking of shields, the Tang held its ground by the spear wall and the massed volleys of crossbow bolts.
tactics: 這一役的攻城過程留下來的可考細節有限，戰術輪廓仍可從唐代相關記載與地勢條件推得。吐蕃進攻石堡城的步驟相當典型：第一步是以高原騎兵切斷唐廷的援軍與糧道，使石堡成為沒有外援的孤城；第二步是集中兵力攻擊城中唯一可攀登的北面坡道，兵力不分散，一處突破即可帶動全局；第三步是城破之後就地接管城防，收降守卒、遷移城內居民，並在城頭樹起自己的旗幟。唐廷事後的反應同樣說明這一役的教訓：此後二十年的西北用兵，幾乎每一次都圍繞著奪回石堡城這個目標展開，而唐軍真正在這條線上得手，是在天寶八載的攻堅中完成的。那次攻堅的樣板也由此確立：先以輕兵斷絕城中水源，再以重兵填塞唯一通道，士卒分批輪換、分層堆築攻城台，一寸一寸往城頭推；圍城數月，付出極大死傷代價才攻下城中。岑參在詩裡描述的正是士卒在懸崖之下進退不得的處境。就石堡本身的地形而言，城踞湟水南岸的黃土台地，三面崖壁，高處俯瞰通道，這意味著任何攻方都無法展開人海，只能靠窄徑與器械硬攻。
tacticsEn: The details that survive of the siege itself are few, but the shape of the operation can still be reconstructed from the Tang accounts and from the ground. The Tibetan attack on Shibao followed a typical three-stage form. First, light cavalry on the plateau cut the Tang reinforcement and supply lines, reducing the fortress to an isolated stronghold with no relief. Second, the assault was concentrated on the single ramp by which the plateau could be climbed, with the force not dispersed, so that one breach carried the whole position with it. Third, once the walls were taken the defenders were settled in place: surrendered troops were enrolled, the population of the town was moved off, and their own banners were raised on the ramparts. The Tang response teaches the same lesson from the other side. For the next twenty years almost every campaign in the north-west was organised around the recovery of Shibao, and the Tang only actually gained ground on this front through the assault of the eighth year of Tianbao. That assault also fixed the model: light troops first cut the water supply inside the city, then heavy troops plugged the only passage, and men were rotated in shifts to build up the siege ramp in layers, pushing it by inches toward the wall; the investment lasted several months and the casualties were appalling before the place fell. Cen's poem pictures the soldiers stuck below the cliff with no way forward or back. As for Shibao itself, the town stands on a loess terrace above the south bank of the Huangshui with cliffs on three sides and a commanding view down the corridor, which means an attacker could never deploy a mass of men and could only grind upward along the narrow path with instruments.
data: 石堡城之戰留下的數字極少，較可用的有幾項。其一，年代：戰役繫於唐玄宗開元十七年（729），本篇沿用維基百科戰爭列表所列的年份；月份方面，開元十七年正值唐蕃在青海與河西前線的反覆爭奪，出兵多在秋收前後，而史籍未載明確日月，故取八月。其二，地理：石堡城在鄯州湟源縣境內，即今青海省海東市湟源縣西南、湟水南岸的黃土台地，《新唐書·地理志》把它列在鄯州之下，遺址距湟源縣城僅數里，控湟水兩岸通道，是河西走廊通往青海與西域的捷徑；城本身規模不大，考古調查所見為依崖而築的夯土城垣與甕城遺構，可屯數百人。其三，兵力：唐方守軍與城丁的具體數字不見於史籍，只知屬邊軍中的小單位；吐蕃方面，舊籍有明顯誇張的眾兵記載，現代研究者多認為實際投入當在數萬之內，確數不可考。其四，時間跨度：城陷之後吐蕃控制石堡城約二十年，直到天寶八載（749）唐軍才以數月之功重新奪回；其後因安史之亂守軍東撤，757年吐蕃復取此城，763年吐蕃進逼長安之役中，唐廷一度借西蕃兵平亂，此城歸屬亦隨之反覆。其五，卡面兵器：羅馬方陣盾定型於西元前一世紀，比本役早八百餘年，不可能出現在青藏高原的戰場上。
dataEn: Very few figures survive from the battle of Shibao, and the following are the usable ones. First, the dating: the action is tied to Kaiyuan 17 of the reign of Xuanzong, that is 729, and this account keeps the year given in Wikipedia's list of wars; as for the month, Kaiyuan 17 was a year of repeated contest in the Qinghai-Hexi sector, when expeditions were customarily launched after the autumn harvest, and since the sources give no clear day or month the eighth is taken. Second, the geography: Shibao lay in Huangyuan county of Shan prefecture, that is southwest of present Huangyuan in Haidong, Qinghai, on a loess terrace above the south bank of the Huangshui; the Xin Tang Shu places it under Shan prefecture in its geographical treatise, the site lies only a few li from the modern county town, and it commands the corridor along the river, the short road from the Hexi Corridor into Qinghai and further west. The town itself was small: archaeological survey shows rammed-earth curtain walls built against the scarp and the remains of a barbican, and it could hold several hundred men. Third, strength: no exact number for the Tang garrison and town militia appears in the records, only that they belonged to a small unit of the frontier army; on the Tibetan side the old books give conspicuously inflated figures, and modern work puts the force actually engaged at somewhere in the tens of thousands at most, the exact number being irrecoverable. Fourth, the span: the city stood in Tibetan hands for about twenty years until the Tang retook it after several months of work in the eighth year of Tianbao (749); then the An Lushan rebellion pulled the garrison eastward, the Tibetans took the place again in 757, and in 763, when the Tibetans advanced on Chang'an, the Tang borrowed western-tribal troops to put out the fire, so that even the ownership of the fortress reversed itself. Fifth, the card weapon: the Roman scutum was settled in the first century BC, more than eight hundred years before this action, and could not have been on a battlefield on the Tibetan plateau.
cause: 石堡城之所以成為必爭之地，首先是地理。湟水自青海高原東流而下，沿途高寒的氣候使唐軍的戰馬與重裝在盛夏難以作戰，秋冬才是雙方出兵的高峰；而石堡城扼住湟水通道上的一處高台，向北可窺鄯州、湟州，向南通向青海與吐谷渾腹地，向西即接河西走廊。唐人自己看得清楚，說得石堡城則斷絕了河西與青海的往來。開元年間，吐蕃在青海一線得手，吐谷渾諸部也多已歸附，攻取石堡城便是把唐朝的邊防從前線推回盆地內側，把唐軍在青海方向的據點連根拔去。推動攻城的另一重因素是唐蕃之間脆弱的平衡：開元初年雙方曾經互有往來，邊境上維持著表面的安定，但吐谷渾內部的變亂給了吐蕃插手其內政、重新取得向東推進跳板的機會。於是開元十七年秋，吐蕃聯軍把兵鋒指向石堡城，唐廷雖派兵救援，卻未能扭轉孤城被攻破的結局。這場衝突不是偶發的遭遇戰，而是唐蕃在青海—河西一線長線競爭中，一個關鍵節點的爭奪。
causeEn: Shibao became an unavoidable point of contention first of all because of its geography. The Huangshui runs east off the Qinghai plateau, and the cold of the high country makes it hard for Tang horses and heavy troops to fight in high summer, so the campaign season for both sides fell in autumn and winter. Shibao sits on a high shoulder of the river: to the north it watches Shan and Huang, to the south it opens onto the belly of Qinghai and Tuyuhun, and to the west it joins the Hexi Corridor. The Tang themselves saw this clearly and held that whoever held Shibao cut the traffic between Hexi and Qinghai. Through the Kaiyuan years the Tibetans made their gains in the Qinghai sector and the Tuyuhun tribes had largely submitted, so taking Shibao meant pushing the Tang frontier back into the basin and tearing out the Tang foothold toward Qinghai root and branch. A second factor behind the assault was the fragility of the Tang-Tibetan balance. In the early Kaiyuan years there had been exchange between the two states and a superficial peace on the frontier, but disorder inside Tuyuhun gave the Tibetans the chance to meddle in its politics and to recover a springboard for pushing east. So in the autumn of Kaiyuan 17 the Tibetan coalition turned its arms against Shibao; the Tang sent aid, but could not save the isolated fortress. This was not a chance encounter but the contest for one decisive point in the long struggle along the Qinghai-Hexi line.
impact: 石堡城陷落的後果，超出一次邊寨得失的範圍，而改變了唐朝西北邊防的整體格局。第一，通道被卡：石堡城在吐蕃手中二十年，唐軍任何一次從河西向青海方向的反擊或輸送都要先解決這個節點，邊防線被迫收縮到湟水以東，河湟一帶的經營停滯。第二，戰略樣板被迫改變：既然正面強攻代價太高，唐廷在開元、天寶之間的西北用兵長期圍繞迂迴、離間與斷糧三個方向打轉，直到哥舒翰在天寶八載以極大代價硬攻得手，邊線的難題才算暫時解決。第三，兵力的代價被如實記錄：749年那一戰士卒死者以萬計，岑參的詩之所以動人，正因為他把將士的傷亡與徒勞寫進了字句；此役之後朝廷在石堡置軍，又在755年安史之亂爆發後被迫放棄。第四，長期的反覆易手最終定型了此地的政治歸屬：唐末吐蕃控制線退往更西，763年吐蕃軍曾進逼長安，其後數度攻取隴右、河湟要地，石堡城始終是雙方爭奪的支點，直到晚唐仍是西北邊防的關鍵。第五，在文獻層面，這座小城留下的分量遠大於它的規模：唐代邊防史裡每次提到石堡城，都帶著軍事與政治雙重的沉重。
impactEn: The fall of Shibao reached well beyond the loss of a border post; it rearranged the whole structure of the Tang defence in the north-west. First, the corridor was blocked: for twenty years while the fortress was Tibetan, every Tang move from Hexi toward Qinghai, offensive or logistical, had to begin with that node, and the frontier contracted to the east of the Huangshui, so that the cultivation of the Hetao region stalled. Second, the approach to war had to be rewritten. Since frontal assault cost too much, Tang campaigning through the Kaiyuan and Tianbao years ran for a long time on three expedients, outflanking, division and cutting of supplies, and it was not until Geshu Han bought the place at a terrible price in the eighth year of Tianbao that the problem on this line was settled, for a time. Third, the cost in men was recorded honestly: the fighting of 749 killed tens of thousands, and Cen's poem moves because it puts the deaths and the futility of the soldiers into the words themselves; the court then established a garrison at Shibao, and abandoned it again when the An Lushan rebellion broke out in 755. Fourth, the long alternation of ownership in the end fixed the political fate of the place: as the Tibetan line in the west retreated further, the Tibetans advanced on Chang'an in 763 and took strongholds in Longyou and Hetao more than once, and Shibao remained the pivot both sides fought over, a key point of the north-western frontier as late as the late Tang. Fifth, in the written record the small fortress weighs far more than its size: every mention of Shibao in Tang frontier history carries a double weight of military and political meaning.
result: 結果是吐蕃攻取石堡城成功，唐朝失去了這個位於湟水通道的邊防支點。城破之後，守軍或戰死、或被俘，城內居民多被遷往吐蕃控制區，吐蕃以自己的旗幟接管城防，並把石堡作為向東推進與控制青海的支撐點。對唐廷而言，此役是一記悶棍：開元年間多次企圖收復都未成功，直到天寶八載（749）才由哥舒翰領軍，以斷水、分批進攻與築台強推的方式攻下此城，付出的傷亡極為慘重；城克之後唐廷在此置石堡軍，隸屬隴右節度使。但好景不長，安史之亂爆發後邊軍東調，757年石堡城再度落入吐蕃手中，763年吐蕃進逼長安時此城仍在對方控制之下，其後數度易手，直至唐末才最終遠離吐蕃的勢力範圍。若只看729年這一次的直接結果，那是一次乾淨的攻堅勝利；若看後續二十年的戰線推移，那麼這座要塞把唐朝在青海一線的推進整整延後了兩代人。
resultEn: The result was that the Tibetans took Shibao and the Tang lost this foothold on the Huangshui corridor. After the walls fell, the garrison was killed or taken captive, much of the population of the town was moved off into Tibetan-held territory, the Tibetans took over the defences with their own banners, and Shibao became a base for pushing east and for holding Qinghai. For the Tang court the affair was a blow in the stomach: every attempt to recover the place in the Kaiyuan years failed, and it was not until the eighth year of Tianbao (749) that Geshu Han led an army to take it, cutting the water and pushing up a ramp in successive shifts at a staggering cost in lives; afterwards the court set up a Stone Fortress Army there under the Longyou Circuit. The relief was short. When the An Lushan rebellion erupted the frontier troops were pulled east, and in 757 Shibao fell back into Tibetan hands; the fortress was still in Tibetan control when the Tibetans moved on Chang'an in 763, and ownership changed hands repeatedly afterwards until the late Tang, when it finally passed out of reach of Tibetan power. Judged only by its immediate outcome, 729 was a clean victory in an assault. Judged by what the next twenty years of frontier movements did, this one fortress held back the Tang advance in the Qinghai direction for the better part of two generations.
